title: Sindhu Storms into French Open Semifinals
indian_angle: India's top women's singles player, P.V. Sindhu, continues her strong run at the French Open, securing a spot in the semifinals.
summary: P.V. Sindhu defeated Chiu Pin-Chian to advance to the French Open semifinals, where she awaits either Putri Wardani of Indonesia or Hina Akechi of Japan.

title: Thulasimathi Murugesan Clinches Para Asian Games Gold
indian_angle: Thulasimathi Murugesan's gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton significantly contributes to India's best-ever medal haul at the Asian Para Games.
summary: Thulasimathi Murugesan, alongside Manasi Joshi, secured a gold medal in women's doubles SL3-SU5 badminton at the Asian Para Games, adding to her two silver medals from earlier in the day.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Upsets World No. 2 Yamaguchi at French Open
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha delivered a stunning performance, becoming only the second Indian woman to defeat world No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi.
summary: Indian southpaw Ashmita Chaliha caused a major upset at the French Open, defeating world No. 2 Akane Yamaguchi 21-19, 21-18, marking a significant career victory.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee ensures greater player representation and input into the governance of Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aimed at empowering players and providing them a voice in key decisions.

title: Junior World Championships Coaching Camp Underway in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior shuttlers are undergoing intensive training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on preparing India's young talent.
